wrong_total.description: Checkout/order total is incorrect even though checkout request completes.
wrong_total.expected_recommended_action: Investigate checkout/order total calculation before release.
wrong_total.disable_or_reset: Unset NOVACART_DEFECT_SCENARIO or set it to an empty value, then restart NovaCart.

frontend_render_failure.description: The backend succeeds, but an important confirmation-page UI element fails to render.
frontend_render_failure.disable_or_reset: Unset NOVACART_DEFECT_SCENARIO or set it to an empty value, then restart NovaCart.

slow_confirmation.description: Checkout completes successfully but confirmation takes longer than the acceptable test threshold.
slow_confirmation.disable_or_reset: Unset NOVACART_DEFECT_SCENARIO or set it to an empty value, then restart NovaCart.

dependency_unavailable.description: NovaCart depends on a backend/service call that returns HTTP 503 or is unavailable.
dependency_unavailable.expected_recommended_action: Investigate downstream service availability and retry/failure handling.
dependency_unavailable.disable_or_reset: Unset NOVACART_DEFECT_SCENARIO or set it to an empty value, then restart NovaCart.

broken_test_locator.description: The application still works for a user, but the Playwright locator is outdated or intentionally mismatched.
broken_test_locator.disable_or_reset: Unset NOVACART_DEFECT_SCENARIO or set it to an empty value, then restart NovaCart.
